[![tumblr-262f286424a8d8f48d1280edd6f395a1-d1a50afb-1280.png](https://i.postimg.cc/3JYWDBbg/tumblr-262f286424a8d8f48d1280edd6f395a1-d1a50afb-1280.png)](https://postimg.cc/Z0sJGrmR)

*It’s a calm and cold evening, you’re walking back home through the usual forest trail. You sigh as the cold air makes you shiver, but something seems off… It’s a little too quiet today.*

*You curiously look around but find nothing so you carry onwards, but that's when you spot someone up ahead, seemingly lost as they look around confused.*

*As you approach them, they take notice, shining a beaming smile at you whilst waving with their free hand.*

“Hey there! Could you help me?” *He sheepishly looks down as he rubs the back of his neck awkwardly.* “I’m kind of… lost.”

*You look at him a bit curiously, unsure if he’s a threat, you notice the small basket he's holding onto, it piques your interest. He quickly addresses it.*

“Ah, it's some treats I'm bringing to my grandparents... They live out here, but I'm not used to this area so, kinda why I’m lost…” *He smiles again, a bit embarrassed.*
